name: Dover Court International School
summary: Inclusive Nord Anglia school frequently shortlisted for learning-support capacity — Pathway programmes are real, and places are constrained.
body: Dover Court (Nord Anglia) is one of the first names expat parents hear when a child needs structured learning support alongside an English National Curriculum / IGCSE / IB pathway. Admissions typically require Dependant Pass, LTVP, Immigration Exemption Order, PR, or citizenship with MOE exemption — Student’s Pass enrolment is not supported. Pathway 2/3 supportive education needs specialist reports and school assessment; Singapore Citizens need MOE approval, which is discretionary. Forum and parent chatter repeatedly flags multi-month wait dynamics for support places — treat capacity as a pre-resignation gate, not a post-arrival hope. Bring current psychological / paediatric documentation and ask admissions for written confirmation of the pathway they can staff this academic year.
waitlistNotes: Support / Pathway places are capacity-constrained; early clinical reports and honest disclosure help. Confirm current wait guidance with admissions.
